les: Wol op die skaap, trui in die winkel
kaps_punt: Goedere: Grondstowwe (primêre produkte), Vervaardigde goedere (sekondêre produkte)

items.bewering: 'n Trui hang in 'n winkel, maar die wol het op 'n skaap gegroei.
items.bron: National Wool Growers' Association of SA, 'The ABCs of wool processing' (nwga.co.za/the-abcs-of-wool-processing/): wool is shorn from sheep on the farm and processed into yarn for knitted garments.

items.bewering: Elke jaar skeer 'n boer die wol van die skaap af.
items.bron: NWGA, 'The ABCs of wool processing': sheep were traditionally shorn once a year; some producers still shear every twelve months, many now every eight or six months. Shearing happens every year in all cases, so the sentence is true; it does not claim 'once a year'.

items.bewering: Die wol lê dan in 'n groot sak en is nog net wol. Niemand het dit nog in iets anders verander nie.
items.bron: NWGA, 'The ABCs of wool processing': wool is shorn, classed and baled on the farm and sold greasy at auction; scouring, carding, combing and spinning all happen later, off the farm.

items.bewering: Iets wat so uit die natuur kom, noem ons 'n grondstof.
items.bron: KABV Sosiale Wetenskappe Gr 4-6, Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 2, gedrukte bl. 30: 'Grondstowwe (primêre produkte)'; Britannica Money, 'industry' (via search excerpt): the primary sector covers agriculture, forestry, fishing, mining and extraction of natural resources.

items.bewering: Boere plant en oes party grondstowwe, en vissers haal ander uit die see. Myners haal erts uit die grond, en werkers kap bome in 'n bos.
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 structure: Section A Agriculture, forestry and fishing (01 crop and animal production, 02 forestry and logging, 03 fishing), Section B Mining and quarrying; Britannica Money 'industry' (search excerpt) lists the same activities as the primary sector.

items.bewering: Iemand moet die wol eers tot 'n lang draad spin. Daarna word daardie draad ry vir ry tot 'n trui gebrei.
items.bron: NWGA, 'The ABCs of wool processing': fibres are drawn into thinner strands and twisted into yarn, which is used for knitted garments; 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica 'Knitting' and Dictionary.com 'knit': fabric formed from interlocking loops of yarn, made in consecutive rows. Note: scouring, carding and combing come before spinning; the sentence reads as spinning before knitting, which is true, and does not claim spinning is the very first step.

items.bewering: Die trui is nou iets heel anders as die wol waarmee begin is. Ons noem so 'n nuwe ding 'n vervaardigde goed.
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 Section C Manufacturing (unstats.un.org): manufacturing is the transformation of materials into new products; KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 2, bl. 30: 'Vervaardigde goedere (sekondêre produkte)'.

items.bewering: Vervaardigde goedere word meestal in 'n fabriek of 'n werkswinkel gemaak.
items.bron: UN ISIC Section C Manufacturing (unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/Structure/Detail/EN/27/C): manufacturing units are 'often described as plants, factories or mills'; units transforming materials by hand or in the worker's home are also included. 'Meestal' is therefore the right quantifier.

items.bewering: Mense koop en verkoop grondstowwe sowel as vervaardigde goedere. 'n Boer verkoop sy wol, en 'n winkel verkoop die trui.
items.bron: NWGA, 'The ABCs of wool processing': baled wool goes to brokers in Gqeberha (Port Elizabeth), is sold at auction and shipped for processing; KABV Gr 6 Kw 2 bl. 30 lists both grondstowwe and vervaardigde goedere under 'Waarmee mense handel dryf'.

items.bewering: 'n Grondstof word ook 'n primêre produk genoem.
items.bron: KABV Sosiale Wetenskappe Gr 4-6, Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 2, gedrukte bl. 30: 'Grondstowwe (primêre produkte)'.

items.bewering: Primêr is die eerste stap waar iets uit die natuur gehaal word.
items.bron: Britannica Money, 'industry' (search excerpt): the primary sector is the extraction of natural resources (agriculture, forestry, fishing, mining), on which secondary industry builds. 'Eerste' here is an ordinal for the stage of production, not a historical first, and it holds.

items.bewering: 'n Vervaardigde goed word 'n sekondêre produk genoem.
items.bron: KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 2, gedrukte bl. 30: 'Vervaardigde goedere (sekondêre produkte)'.

items.bewering: Sekondêr is al die maakwerk saam, en dit maak nie saak hoeveel keer 'n goed verander nie.
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 (unstats.un.org): flour milling (class 1061), basic iron and steel (class 2410) and motor vehicles (class 2910) all sit in Section C Manufacturing, i.e. a first transformation and a later one on an already-made good fall in the same sector; sector-model sources describe the secondary sector as transforming raw OR intermediate materials into goods, e.g. steel into cars.

items.bewering: Die twee woorde sê niks oor hoe goed of hoe belangrik iets is nie.
items.bron: Britannica Money 'industry' and UN ISIC sections: primary and secondary name the stage of production (extraction vs. transformation), not a ranking of quality or importance.

items.bewering: Koring word tot meel gemaal, en bakkers bak brood daarvan.
items.blok: Nog drie pare om self na te loop
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 class 1061 'Manufacture of grain mill products' (unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/Structure/Detail/EN/27/1061): 'production of flour ... of wheat'; bakery products follow in the same division 10.

items.bewering: Ystererts kom uit 'n myn, en 'n fabriek maak staal daarvan.
items.blok: Nog drie pare om self na te loop
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 class 2410 'Manufacture of basic iron and steel' (unstats.un.org): steelmaking from iron ore or scrap in blast furnaces, oxygen converters or electric arc furnaces; Wikipedia 'Iron ore': about 98% of mined iron ore is used to make steel, via pig iron.

items.bewering: Hout kom van 'n boom, en 'n houtwerker maak 'n stoel daarvan.
items.blok: Nog drie pare om self na te loop
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4: Section A division 02 Forestry and logging (timber from trees) and Section C Manufacturing (wood products and furniture).

items.bewering: 'n Fabriek maak staal uit ystererts, en staal is dus self 'n vervaardigde goed.
items.blok: Van ystererts tot staal tot 'n motor
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 class 2410 'Manufacture of basic iron and steel', Section C Manufacturing (unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/Structure/Detail/EN/27/2410).

items.bewering: 'n Fabriek wat motors maak, gebruik daardie staal as materiaal. Die motor is ook 'n vervaardigde goed, en albei is sekondêre produkte.
items.blok: Van ystererts tot staal tot 'n motor
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 class 2910 'Manufacture of motor vehicles', Section C Manufacturing (unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/Structure/Detail/EN/27/2910); sector-model sources give 'steel into cars' as the standard secondary-sector example. Steel is correctly called 'materiaal', not 'grondstof', so it does not clash with the lesson's definition of grondstof.

items.bewering: So kan iets wat een fabriek maak, die materiaal van 'n ander fabriek wees.
items.blok: Van ystererts tot staal tot 'n motor
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 classes 2410 and 2910 (both Section C): steel is the output of one manufacturing class and an input to another; the secondary sector transforms raw or intermediate materials into goods.

items.bewering: grondstof: Iets wat uit die natuur kom en nog nie verander is nie.
items.bron: KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 2, bl. 30 (grondstowwe = primêre produkte); Britannica Money 'industry' (primary sector = extraction of natural resources). Note: in wider English usage 'raw material' can mean any input to manufacturing, but the lesson never applies grondstof to steel, so the definition is consistent with how it is used.

items.bewering: primêre produk: Nog 'n naam vir 'n grondstof, want dit is die eerste stap.
items.bron: KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 2, bl. 30: 'Grondstowwe (primêre produkte)'; Britannica Money 'industry': primary sector is the extraction stage. 'Eerste' is the stage of production, which holds.

items.bewering: vervaardigde goedere: Goedere wat mense maak deur grondstowwe of ander goedere te verander.
items.bron: UN ISIC Rev.4 Section C Manufacturing (unstats.un.org): the physical or chemical transformation of materials, substances or components into new products; classes 2410 and 2910 show both raw and already-made inputs.

items.bewering: sekondêre produk: Nog 'n naam vir 'n vervaardigde goed, hoeveel keer dit ook al verander is.
items.bron: KABV Gr 6 Geografie Kwartaal 2, bl. 30: 'Vervaardigde goedere (sekondêre produkte)'; UN ISIC Rev.4: flour, steel and motor vehicles all in Section C Manufacturing.

items.bewering: ystererts: Klip uit 'n myn waarin daar yster is.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Iron ore' and ispatguru.com 'Understanding iron ores and mining of iron ore': iron ore is rock or mineral from which iron can be economically extracted, mined for steelmaking. The definition omits 'enough iron to be worth extracting', but 'uit 'n myn' carries that narrowing, so it simplifies without becoming false.

opsomming: Al 25 bewerings is teen bronne bevestig (KABV bl. 30, die SA Wolkwekersvereniging, die VN se ISIC-klassifikasie, Britannica en verwysingswerke oor ystererts); daar is geen superlatiewe behalwe 'eerste stap' (twee keer, wat die produksiestap noem en klop), geen analogieë nie, en niks is weerspreek of onseker nie.
